caption: The drawing shows a single candlestick placed on a flat brown surface. The candlestick is cylindrical with a round, slightly raised base that tapers inward before flaring out again at the top, where an indented circular opening is located for holding a candle. The surface of the candlestick is primarily brownish-gold with mottled speckles of green and blue distributed throughout, giving it a textured appearance. The background is a plain, light beige color. At the top of the image, there is text in uppercase letters that reads "CANDLE-STICK CIRCA 1849."
title: Candlestick
